$comment: Shillinq Integrations (platform-integration-catalogue, REQ-PIC-001, REQ-PIC-002, REQ-PIC-003). The cards are integriq's `catalog_item` objects, the catalogue integriq's own Store page reads; shillinq opens on the bookkeeping categories and leaves switching an item on to integriq (ADR-023). The menu entry is not gated on integriq: on an instance without it the page shows the missing-dependency screen naming Integriq, which is what REQ-PIC-003 asks for.

config.description: Ready-made integrations for bookkeeping from integriq's catalogue. Switch one on in integriq.
config._filterNote: The bookkeeping categories (design D1). Removable like any default filter, so the whole catalogue is one click away; when integriq renames a category, this list is the one edit.

actions.label: Open in Integriq
actions.description: Open integriq's catalogue, where this integration is switched on.

config._afterListNote: Not available yet (design D2, REQ-PIC-002): shillinq's own connection families, as integriq's `app_connection` rows synced from lib/Settings/connections.json, each with the reason integriq reports. No family has a bookkeeping catalogue item yet, so every family is listed; once integriq ships one and accepts a catalogue item link in the connection declaration, that family moves into the cards and this list narrows to the rest.

content.emptyText: Every connection family has an integration in the catalogue.
